[[File:Leebsie.png|thumb|right|200px|A leebsie-lurker]]
'''Leebsie-lurker''', or often truncated to simply '''Leebsie''', was insect approximately 10 [[Centimeter/Legends|cm]] length. It's normal diet consisted of the bodies of other insects broken on the air intake grille filters of [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] and [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeders]]. Leebsie were native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
